name: Mirchi Vada
subtitle: jodhpur's fat green chillies stuffed with spiced potato and fried in gram-flour batter

ingredients.note: the big mild ones, roughly 10cm. Thin hot chillies are inedible here

ingredients.qty: 700ml for deep frying, plus 2 tbsp for the filling

ingredients.note: use compounded-free hing to keep this gluten-free

prepNotes: Boil the potatoes an hour ahead and let them cool completely. Warm potato makes a wet filling that leaks into the oil.
Slit each chilli lengthways down one side only, from just below the stem, and scrape out the seeds and white pith with a small spoon. The pith is where the heat sits.
Mix the batter thick, then let it sit 10 minutes so the besan hydrates and clings.

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil, crackle the cumin and fennel, add the hing and grated ginger, and fry 30 seconds.
Add the turmeric, chilli and coriander powders off the heat, then fold in the mashed potato and salt.
Cook 4 minutes over medium heat, then stir in the amchur and coriander leaves and cool completely.
steps.tip: The filling should taste distinctly sour and slightly over-salted. The chilli and batter mute it.

steps.text: Whisk the besan with the ajwain, baking soda, a pinch of salt and enough water to make a batter that thickly coats a spoon and does not run off it.
steps.tip: Runny batter slides off the chilli in the oil. It should be the consistency of soft-set honey.

steps.text: Pack each chilli firmly through its slit with the potato filling and press the slit closed.
Heat the frying oil to 175C. A drop of batter should rise steadily and sizzle without browning instantly.
Dip each stuffed chilli in the batter, turning to coat completely including the ends, and lower it into the oil.
Fry 4-5 minutes, turning once, until the crust is pale gold and crisp. Do no more than three at a time.
steps.tip: Crowding the pan drops the oil temperature and the vadas turn greasy.

steps.text: Drain on paper and serve hot with tamarind or mint chutney, or pushed into a soft bun as Jodhpur does.

storage: Best within an hour of frying. Refrigerate up to 2 days and re-crisp in a 200C oven for 8 minutes. Never the microwave, which turns the crust to paste.

nutrition.method: Estimated from raw ingredients using USDA FoodData Central. Cooking losses are not modelled and added salt is excluded, so sodium is not given.
nutrition.caveat: Much of the weighed input may not be eaten. Syrup left in the bowl, or batter that yields more than the stated servings, means the real figure is likely lower than this.
